# Uchinchi tomon kutubxonalari

CDN’ga bog‘liqlikni yo‘qotish va ta’minot zanjiri xavfini kamaytirish uchun kutubxonalar npm’dagi rasmiy paketlardan o‘zgarishsiz nusxalangan.

| Fayl | Paket | Versiya | Litsenziya |
|---|---|---|---|
| supabase-2.81.1.js | @supabase/supabase-js (dist/umd) | 2.81.1 | MIT |
| exceljs-4.4.0.min.js | exceljs (dist) | 4.4.0 | MIT |
| mammoth-1.13.0.min.js | mammoth (browser build) | 1.13.0 | BSD-2-Clause |
| pdfjs-4.10.38.min.mjs, pdfjs-4.10.38.worker.min.mjs | pdfjs-dist (build) | 4.10.38 | Apache-2.0 |
| pdfmake-0.2.23.min.js, pdfmake-0.2.23.vfs_fonts.js | pdfmake (build; Roboto shrifti — Apache-2.0) | 0.2.23 | MIT |
| docx-9.15.2.iife.js | docx (dist) | 9.15.2 | MIT |

Yangilash: `npm pack <paket>@<versiya>` bilan yuklab, tegishli faylni almashtiring va `npm run test:e2e` ni bajaring.
